parole.testo: Mostly augmented from رَمَّ (ramma, “to mend”) of the root ر م م (r m m). The meaning of rheum is also found in Classical Syriac ܪܷ̈ܡܨܶܐ (remṣē) and hardly native to Arabic, even variating its consonantism to رَمَسَة (ramasa) and رُمُوسَة (rumūsa) in al-Andalus, and غَمَض (ḡamaḍ) meaning a more liqu

parole.significato: to make roll round, to set into orbital motion
